title: President Jokowi Inaugurates Cisumdawu Toll Road

excerpts.text: President Joko “Jokowi” Widodo Tuesday (07/11) inaugurated Cileunyi-Sumedang-Dawuan (Cisumdawu) toll road.
The inauguration ceremony took place in front of the iconic twin tunnels spanning 472 meters on kilometer 169 situated in Rancakalong village, Sumedang regency, West Java province.

“Thank God, today [the construction of] Cisumdawu toll road, Cileunyi-Sumedang-Dawuan toll road is finished and it is ready to operate. The toll road connects us to Bandung through Cipularang and Cipali toll roads,” he said, while expressing hope that the toll road can boost connectivity to Kertajati International Airport in the neighboring Majalengka regency.
